WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(aa.avg_amount) AS region_avg
    FROM account_averages aa
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = aa.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(region_avg) AS overall_avg
    FROM region_averages
)
SELECT ra.region,
       ra.region_avg,
       ra.region_avg - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall_avg,
       ra.region_avg / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall_avg
FROM region_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE ra.region_avg > o.overall_avg;
